patch.detail:
OWNER ASK (2026-09-22, verbatim): "I want users to have a dropdown Vera box to edit their calendar in the Pencil, Planning, Production mode. We can make it more complex later, but I would love a user to be able to ask Vera to create, edit, move, etc, any part of the plan. For example, asking Vera to place a repeating, penciled in event on every new moon and having her figure it out."

THE SHAPE (first cut). A disclosure box above the operator calendar for anyone who can manage the Space: a mode select (Pencil / Planning / Production, the stage new things are created in), one text input, Send. Vera answers by CALLING A TOOL whose input schema is the calendar's own vocabulary (pencil these days as one Plan holding many dates, move this date, change stage, retitle, add a to-do, archive), never by writing. "Every new moon" is a second tool she calls first, lunar_dates, backed by a pure Meeus-algorithm module in lib/calendar/moon.ts tested against the 2026 new moons: computed, never guessed. The proposal renders as plain lines with checkboxes; Accept runs the checked lines through the EXISTING server actions on the caller's own session, one result per line, so a partial failure is visible rather than swallowed. Nothing is written before Accept.

INVARIANTS (ADR-1386): Vera never publishes, sends or books on her own; every output is a proposal the team accepts; no other Space's data reaches a suggestion; all generated copy through lib/ai/voice.ts; the admin client is never on this path; usage is recorded through recordAiUsage and bounded by lib/ai/budget.ts.

DELIBERATELY NOT IN THE FIRST CUT (PROG-CAL11 carries them): multi-turn clarification, editing arbitrary manifest fields, undo of an accepted proposal, attendance-aware date suggestions.

WHY THIS SHAPE. Adding a verb later is a schema row plus an action, not a rebuild; the tool schema is the contract between what Vera may propose and what the product can do, and the product's own actions remain the only writers.

CLOSED 2026-09-22. WHAT SHIPPED (first cut). components/spaces/vera-calendar-box.tsx, mounted from components/spaces/calendar-workspace.tsx above the panels for the team that can edit the calendar: a collapsed "Ask Vera" row that opens to a Mode select (Pencil / Planning / Production, remembered per Space), an ask input (#vera-ask) and Send; then the PROPOSAL as one describeChange line per change with a checkbox (all on), Accept / Discard, and per-line results after Accept. lib/calendar/vera-command.ts: the closed vocabulary of proposed changes (pencil one Plan on many dates, move, stage, retitle, todo, archive), parseVeraChanges (UUID shape, real days, HH:MM, stages from PLAN_STAGE_TRANSITIONS, at most 40 changes, at most 60 dates per pencil, long dashes stripped from titles) and describeChange (plain lines, no long dash, no exclamation). lib/calendar/moon.ts: Meeus ch. 49 new and full moon instants with the periodic and planetary corrections, and lunarPhaseDates(phase, from, to, timeZone) as local days; pinned to every 2026 new moon in moon.test.ts. lib/ai/vera-calendar.ts: proposeCalendarChanges, Sonnet tier, withVoice system prompt stating the invariants, this Space only as context (Plans by id, the visible month's dates by id), two tools (lunar_dates executed by the server and fed back as a tool_result, propose_changes as the required answer), at most three rounds, budget key vera-calendar, per-actor rate limit, one ledger row per ask with the Space attributed, honest errors (AI off, over budget, throttled, unparseable, no proposal). app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/calendar/vera-calendar-actions.ts: veraCalendarCommand (resolveEditor gate, builds context on the caller's session, returns the proposal, WRITES NOTHING) and applyVeraChanges (resolveEditor, re-parses through parseVeraChanges, then drives each change through the existing stores and actions on the caller's session: createPenciledPlanRows for the first date of a new Plan and one insertCalendarEntries per further date so the dates never read as candidates, transitionSpacePlanRows for the chosen mode, updateCalendarEntryRow for a move with reanchorPlanTodos, transitionPlanStage, updateSpacePlan for retitle and archive, addPlanTodo; one result per change, never swallowed; no admin client). StaffCalendar takes an externalRefreshKey so a browsed month refetches after an accepted proposal. docs/EVENTS-CALENDAR.md carries the "Vera on the calendar" paragraph.

THE INVARIANT. Propose then accept. Vera never publishes, sends or books: the vocabulary has no publish kind, the propose door returns before any write, and nothing lands until a person ticks lines and presses Accept. "Every new moon" is computed by lib/calendar/moon.ts, never guessed by the model.

DELIBERATELY NOT IN THE FIRST CUT. A follow-up question from Vera (one ask, one proposal; an ambiguous ask comes back as a note and a smaller proposal). Editing arbitrary manifest fields of a Plan (notes, links, target, playbook). Undo of an accepted proposal (archive is reversible by hand on the Plan; a move is a move). Vera reading attendance or past turnout to pick dates. The time zone is the browser's, as the staff drawer already sends it, because a Space carries no zone of its own.2026-11-27 (SCAN-1344): the public Calendar tab stopped carrying its own team mode, per the owner ruling of 2026-11-25 ("Public only, link to team"). The team half of this row now lives on the team calendar at /spaces/<slug>/settings/calendar; the probe was rewritten to measure that. 2026-11-27 (owner chose Ask Vera on the team calendar): the check now measures the real Vera, not the command bar parser that only shares its placeholder wording. The suite mounts VeraCalendarBox in its own sheet, the bar hands it what was typed, and the box still proposes through veraCalendarCommand and holds Accept on a destructive line.
